UI: Move-to select offers adjacent stages and 'Reopen to <rejected_from>'; Up/Down reorder; checkbox multi-select with bulk bar; optimistic move, put back on refusal with reason in role=alert and focus returned to the card's select (board.js l.166-205); rejected-from and reason on card (l.255) and details (l.131); undo button from boot.undo; add-candidate fault at the email field with typed values kept (l.52-55); 'Interview (n of N places)' heading and manager facts; Activity newest first with per-job filter and 'Show more'; message bodies via textContent with white-space:pre-wrap (styles.css l.105); Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and refocused, draft cleared on send; per-user per-conversation localStorage drafts (app.js l.74-78) and note drafts (board.js l.98); any 401 returns to sign-in with email prefilled (app.js l.69, l.232-238); network failure shows 'Not sent...' and keeps the text (threads.js l.195); scrolled-up arrival shows 'N new message(s)' without moving scrollTop or marking read (l.153-159); earlier-page prepend keeps on-screen position (l.168-172); in-place patching keeps note/message drafts, focus and scroll (board.js l.323-339). Every criterion leg traced is satisfiable by the reference; no criterion the golden cannot pass, so no P0. RESIDUAL RISK (risk=true): (1) No configured judge run, Oracle grade or judge-duration measurement exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'); whether the 40-criterion Functional protocol completes within the 9000 s judge timeout with the frozen GLM judge is unmeasured, so 'the oracle can score high' is plausible but not demonstrated. (2) Lesson 19 (extend the golden harness with every criterion leg): workspace.cjs has no job-open refusal legs (blank/0/51/2.5/recruiter-as-manager), no aborted or offline send (hro_pol_failed_send), no per-job Activity filter or line-completeness check, and no live candidate-wording change leg; these are source-traced only. (3) P3 latent race in hro_unread_counts' 'does not rise' leg: on a live update, threads.js update() calls renderList() and app.js render() calls paintNavBadges() with the bootstrap unread=1 for the open conversation (threads.js l.204-207, app.js l.147-150); it is zeroed only after catchUp's awaited GET ?after= (threads.js l.150-158). The driver checks the nav total only after the message is visible (workspace.cjs l.466-467), when it is already zero, so the transient is never measured; the judge's 500 ms DOM poll from t0 for 15 s could catch it with low probability and fail a weight-2 row. Minor notes: emails are stored and shown lowercased (index.js l.221), so a mixed-case entry is displayed differently; undo Activity lines name only the restored stage ('... is back in Applied').
counterexample: Conforming-alternative probe applied to the golden itself: Rafael has Tomas's conversation open at its newest message; Tomas sends one message; the SSE-triggered refresh paints the row badge '1' and the nav total +1 from /api/bootstrap before catchUp's GET ?after= resolves and markRead zeroes them. A judge DOM read that lands in that few-millisecond window records a rise and fails hro_unread_counts (weight 2) for the reference. Weak-app probe for this row: no criterion found that the golden fails while a weak app passes.
suggested_fix: In threads.js update(), render the open, active, at-newest conversation's unread as 0 before painting (or defer renderList/paintNavBadges until catchUp completes); extend the scripted golden driver to poll from the trigger and add the uncovered legs; obtain a full configured judge/Oracle run before claiming the oracle scores high.
